trigger.description: Start this workflow automatically on a repeating schedule, like every hour, every day, or every week.
trigger.name: trigger

parameters.description: How many units between each run (e.g. 1 for every unit, 2 for every other unit). The interval must be at least 60 seconds.
parameters.name: interval

returns.description: No output. This starts the workflow on its schedule.

description: Run workflows automatically on a schedule.
